item.title: 50 percent of Americans saving for college don't know about a 529 savings plan: survey
item.description: Despite the many advantages 529 savings plans provide, many Americans are not using them as part of the education saving strategy, a recent Edward Jones survey said.

item.title: Another EV adoption obstacle in America: Thieves are stealing charging cables
item.description: The latest obstacle for U.S. automakers in their effort to convert more Americans to electric vehicles? Thieves have been targeting EV charging stations.Criminals have been intent on stealing the cables, which contain copper wiring, officials say. item.description: NASA confirmed that there was "no emergency situation" aboard the International Space Station on Wednesday after audio of a medical drill was accidentally played on a public livestream channel, prompting concern on social media. item.title: You can renew your US passport online again with limited trial program
item.description: Online passport renewal is back in the U.S. with limited capacity. The U.S. State Department has relaunched a beta program for renewing your passport online, with plans to gradually increase capacity each day, reports say. According to the State Department, a limited number of eligible Americans will be allowed to submit applications online at a "midday eastern time window" each day. item.description: Pat Sajak is moving on from his storied job as the host of "Wheel of Fortune" with his reputation and ratings "intact." item.description: A new report says the amount service industry workers are tipped in the U.S., on average, depends on where you live.
